card.name: Words leading into intravenous infusion
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside 'intravenous infusion' in chemotherapy dosing, such as 'as a' or 'intr-avenous'. Also words before a drink or liquid, like 'fruit' before juice.

modes.label: Before IV infusion
modes.description: Small words or word parts such as 'as a' and 'intr' that lead into a continuous intravenous infusion after fluorouracil.
modes.example: by cisplatin 75 mg/m 2 intravenously over 1 hour, on day one, followed by fluorouracil as<< a>> continuous intravenous infusion at 75

modes.label: Liquids to drink
modes.description: Words that lead into a beverage, such as juice, milk or tea, in a dilution or serving instruction.
modes.example: 0.3 mL (300 mg) or 0.6 mL (600 mg) diluted in one glassful of water,<< fruit>> juice or milk 3 to 4

card.writes: It pushes the model toward the word 'drink' and its forms, which suits the liquid mode.
card.plain: It lights up on the words that lead into an intravenous infusion, and sometimes into a drink like juice or tea.
